method: Independent inspection of the native PNG and its identity/style reference with view_image, followed by read-only pixel measurements. Presence never implies approval. No images modified.

The Vortex Abyssal brief explicitly requests a dark needle-like torpedo and says the reference is for finish rather than identity. A distinct coherent torpedo body for both base and evolution is required. The sheet otherwise has eight distinct right-facing pulses on the intended grid.

Native image inspected visually against the finish reference and Couronne d’Épines brief. The green energy lance has an ornate botanical body with gold vine filigree, a surrounding crown of crimson crystal thorns and amber pollen sparks, visibly distinct from the reference's mechanical Vulcan body.

Reject for halo clipping across cell boundaries: frames 3 and 4 have zero alpha>24 margin, with 58 and 205 boundary pixels above that threshold. The separator between those frames reaches alpha 27, while frame 4's outer-right edge reaches alpha 40 with 144 pixels above 24. This is materially stronger than the alpha 1–3 noise tolerated in other native atlases and will leave a cut halo when frames are extracted. Regenerate a compact glow; do not clean or crop the native PNG.

Native image inspected visually alongside the Vulcan Cerberus reference. It retains the reference's mechanical silver arrowhead carapace, three longitudinal luminous bars, magenta triangular fins and rear assembly, then adds an icy leading tip and aurora glow.

The Faisceau Cryo-Laser brief asks for a narrow pale-cyan laser lance with faceted ice segments and says the reference is for finish rather than projectile identity. The reused mechanical dart body does not satisfy that identity. Regenerate a distinct faceted ice/laser projectile; the frame layout alone is not grounds for approval.
